audited_head: nine color prints and nine line prints of batch 41, the three control rows (a-nose, a-nut, practice-line-nose) with six files, the four cast reference sheets (cast group A, cast group B, the Nan look reference, the Ben sheet), the six prop reference sheets (balls, birds, cupcakes, ducks, kites, school bag), zoom crops of Pip's head, joined hands, Teacher Kim's open hand, both cakes plates, the cover top band, the a-nose face in both files, the a-nut open hand in both files, and the writer checks quoted in the brief
verdict: all nine batch rows pass under the bar; of the three control rows, C3 passes and C1 and C2 fail

line_file_gray_count.method: every pixel of every line file counted with sharp greyscale raw output; a pixel counts as gray when it is not 0 and not 255
line_file_gray_count.result: 0 gray pixels in all nine 1920x1280 line files, all nine 4000x3000 line prints, and the three 4000x3000 or 1600x1600 control line files

line_art_thickness_scan.method: a chamfer distance map from every black pixel to the nearest white pixel on each line print, then a flood scan of the pixels deeper than 20 px
line_art_thickness_scan.result: in the nine batch prints every deep cluster is a round eye pupil, the largest 145 x 145 px with depth 83 px; in the control line files the a-nose print holds 13 deep pixels in one 6 x 4 px mark, the a-nut print holds none, and the practice-line nose holds one 28 x 88 px solid eye oval with depth 35 px; no deep cluster is long or thin
line_art_thickness_scan.judgement: no thick solid black ring and no thick solid black band stands in any line file of this review; the writer reports batch line widths of 12 to 27 px, all above the 12 px minimum

line_gap_scan.method: a chamfer distance map from every white pixel to the nearest black pixel, then a flood from every white area wider than 15 px; the white pixels the flood cannot reach form closed gaps thinner than 15 px
line_gap_scan.result: in the nine batch prints the closed gaps measure at most 15 px wide; they sit between parallel strokes: finger gaps, sandal straps, stone joints, hair slots and clothing folds; no gap sits inside a face or across a palm; the three control line files were read at full size and show open, even strokes with no closed thin gap in a face or a hand
line_gap_scan.judgement: no line gap makes the coloring hard
